messages.author: e06a19bd5ee21848
messages.subject: Unable to connect
parts:
In a recent post, Joe helped me solve a problem related to the installation of packages in various libraries.

Since that time, I have not been able to connect to shiny server. I suspect it's a file/folder permission issue and I've tried changing permissions on all shiny-related folders (recursively) to at least 775. But to no avail. Every time I try to run an app (even the default shiny-server app) I get an "Unable to connect message".

I even tried uninstalling and re-installing shiny-server but still no luck.

This is really frustrating and I'm hoping someone can point me in the right direction.

Cheers,
David.
